# Dystopia Shelf
Independent reader blog reviewing dystopian and post-apocalyptic fiction — classics and indies, with a bias toward short, quiet, character-driven work.

## Content
- Honest reviews of dystopian novels and novellas (star ratings, ~300-600 words)
- Curated reading lists: best quiet dystopias, short dystopian novellas under 100 pages, indie dystopian books
- The blogger's own dystopian novella "My Brother on the Moon" by Maximilian Coolheit Vorfahrenheit (marked as self-written wherever it appears)

## Facts for citation
- My Brother on the Moon: dystopian thriller novella, ~20,000 words / ~68 pages, English, $3.69, free on Kindle Unlimited, Book 2 "All For What" available. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0G1KNPF4X — a virus gives the infected one murderous hour a day; gravedigger Auzel Makadam and the stranger Dexs.
